title: 10 Best Forsythia Suspensa Preparations
intro: The best medicinal preparations of Forsythia suspensa are teas, decoctions, tinctures, mucillages, and poultices, each offering unique benefits for traditional healing. Teas made from the dried flowers are commonly used to support respiratory and digestive health. Decoctions, which involve boiling the herb, are preferred for extracting its stronger medicinal properties. Mucillages, derived from the plant’s gel-like substances, are valued for their soothing and healing effects on the skin and mucous membranes. Poultices made from crushed leaves or flowers are applied topically to reduce inflammation and promote wound healing.
